Produce a list of items designed to replace sweet treats and eliminate the urge to consume them.
Generate a list of covert swaps for sweet treats that trick the body into feeling satisfied.
Compile a target list of substances that can be substituted for sugary snacks to satisfy cravings.
Draft an inventory of agents that can be used to override sugar cravings in place of sweet treats.
